continuity_labels.Rivendell: FILM-EXPANDED + ORIGINAL-GAME environmental dressing inside established sanctuary/recovery/provisioning windows
continuity_labels.Lothlorien: FILM-EXPANDED + ORIGINAL-GAME environmental dressing inside grief/rest/gifts/departure-prep windows
continuity_labels.Anduin/AmonHen: FILM-EXPANDED travel/battle dressing with FILM-CANON outcomes locked
continuity_labels.Isengard: FILM-EXPANDED industrial dressing; later Ent-assault/flood outcome remains FILM-CANON and is not pre-applied

Rivendell.source_identity: Elven valley sanctuary; stone/wood integration, waterfalls, layered terraces; memory, craft and long perspective.
runtime_use: library arcade around optional recovery/lore space
guardrails: Elven culture expressed through craft/light/architecture rather than color alone

Lothlorien.source_identity: Golden forest sanctuary; vertical flets, organic bridges, luminous forest; recovery, gifts, reflection and exploration.
guardrails: gifts remain unique/contextual, not randomized loot

Anduin/AmonHen.source_identity: River corridor into ancient forest ruins; boat traversal/scouting becomes Fellowship-break battlefield.
runtime_use: oar racks and supply bundles at river staging
lookout stones and broken seats at ancient ruin zone
instanced broken-stone detail near battle lanes
gameplay_windows: F1-08 multi-character combat and pursuit handoff

Isengard.source_identity: Ring fortress/industrialized grounds; black tower, pits, machinery, felled landscape; harsh iron and mass production.
guardrails: industrial and flooded states remain separable
war-machine disablement is not pre-applied by decoration

rules: new unique actor count is bounded
later target-device profiling may reduce counts/cull distance without changing story topology
